assertions.assertion: The denial reason code is PR-204.
The CPT code for the service is 93226.
The service is a 48-hour Holter monitoring study.
The payer letter states the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91).
The patient has a history of cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9).
The patient has persistent episodes of palpitations (R00.2).
The palpitations interfere with daily activities.
The 48-hour Holter monitor was ordered for continuous ambulatory electrocardiographic recording.
The purpose of the order is to further characterize the arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances.
